# Change email designs (fixture, text description of 10 frames)

1. "Account settings": email row with "Change email".
2. "Change email form": new email field (label "New email"), current password (label "Current password", show/hide), "Save", "Cancel".
3. "Form errors": three variants shown side by side: "Enter a valid email", "This is already your email", "Password is incorrect". Each error has text and an icon under the field.
4. "Saving": button spinner, fields disabled.
5. "Check your new inbox": text, "Resend" (shows toast "Link sent" after tap, disabled 30s), "Cancel change".
6. "Account settings - pending": email row shows current email and "Pending: new@example.com" with "Cancel".
7. "Email updated": success page with "Back to settings".
8. "Link expired": explanation and "Send again".
9. "Server error": banner "Something went wrong. Your changes were not saved." button "Try again", inputs preserved.
10. "Change cancelled": toast "Email change cancelled" on Account settings.
